NOTICE AND AGENDA
  FOR SPECIAL CLOSED SESSION MEETING

  CITY COUNCIL
  APRIL 8, 2025
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor of the City of Norwalk has called a special meeting of the City
Council beginning at 6:00 PM on April 8, 2025 in the City Council Chambers, Norwalk City Hall, 12700 Norwalk
Boulevard. The agenda for the special meeting is as follows:

CALL TO ORDER
Mayor Ayala

ROLL CALL
Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR CLOSED SESSION MATTERS - Members of the public are entitled to speak
only on the items listed. Please fill out a speaker card and turn it in to the Sergeant at Arms before the meeting
commences.

CLOSED SESSION MATTERS
I  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – EXISTING LITIGATION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT
  CODE §54956.9(d)(1) – State of California vs. City of Norwalk, Case No. 24STCP03551.

II  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – ANTICIPATED LITIGATION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT
  CODE §54956.9(d)(2) – Significant exposure to litigation in one case.

III  PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE §54957.6; CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR.
  Negotiating on behalf of the City: Jesus M. Gomez, City Manager; regarding negotiations with the Norwalk
  City Employees Association.

ADJOURNMENT

I, Theresa Devoy, City Clerk, hereby certify that the foregoing notice of special closed session meeting
was posted at City Hall not less than 24-hours before the start of the meeting and delivered to each
 member of the Norwalk City Council and to the following newspapers: Herald American, Cerritos
Community News, Norwalk Patriot, and Whittier Daily News, all on April 4, 2025.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk

Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in
a City meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk’s office, (562) 929-5720.
Assisted listening devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon
request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet, can be made available in appropriate alternative
formats to persons with a disability. Notification of at least 12 hours prior to the meeting or time when services
are needed will assist the City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
